source: Static, sanitized Power BI Data Agent / Jira semantic model notes
usage_note: Contextual hints only. This prototype has no live Power BI, Fabric, Microsoft, Armada, or Jira connection.

tables.name: E1_Tickets
tables.description: Main historical ticket-level table with ticket key, project, summary, status, assignee, assigned group, priority, created/resolved dates, application, and ticket details.
tables.use_when: General historical ticket questions and ticket-level analysis.

tables.name: OpenTickets
tables.description: Preferred table for active backlog, demand pipeline, ticket age, assignment workload, status, project type, and size estimates.
tables.use_when: Questions about currently open tickets, workload, active demand, or aging.

tables.name: E2_Linked Tickets
tables.description: Relationships between BIM delivery tickets and related SCP or ITO source/request tickets, including 1:1 and 1:many patterns.
tables.use_when: Traceability, source-request links, and downstream delivery relationships.

tables.name: E3_Change Log
tables.description: Status, assignment, reassignment, and field-change history over time.
tables.use_when: Workflow history, bottleneck, reassignment, or status movement analysis.

terminology.BIM: Business Intelligence delivery or development ticket; the usual category for BI work.
terminology.SCP: Service Catalog or product request ticket that may be a source request.
terminology.ITO: IT Operations request ticket that may be a source request.
terminology.CC: Another Jira project category present in the static model context.
terminology.assigned_group: The team or queue responsible for a ticket.
terminology.assignee: The individual assigned to a ticket.

relationship_guidance: BIM tickets are often linked downstream to SCP or ITO source/request tickets.
A BIM ticket may satisfy one source request or address multiple source tickets.
Draft previews may suggest links for traceability but never create them.
high_level_insights: Ticket volume spans ITO, BIM, CC, and SCP; ITO appears largest in the provided sample context.
Most tickets appear to be low priority in the provided sample context.
WMS/Red Prairie and BI-Reporting appear to handle comparatively large volumes.
Some BIM tickets have long resolution times, suggesting possible process bottlenecks.
data_quality_warnings: Assigned group may appear empty for open BIM tickets in current Data Agent results.
Sample open-ticket outputs may contain statuses that appear resolved or closed; validate status semantics before drawing conclusions.
Do not present approximate context observations as live facts or invent exact counts.
